# How much of my equipment spend can I deduct from profit?

> Free UK capital allowances calculator: how much of your equipment spend you can deduct this year under the Annual Investment Allowance, full expensing and writing-down allowances, the best order to use the AIA, and the tax saved. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
